blocks.text: The manager is commended for acting shrewdly in a crisis, not presented as morally exemplary in every respect. The following sayings keep wealth, faithfulness, and divided allegiance in view without endorsing fraud. Likewise, the account of the rich man and Lazarus uses reversal, postmortem imagery, Moses and the Prophets, and an unsuccessful warning to confront wealth and refusal to listen; it should not be read as a complete map of the afterlife.
